verses.sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा कुशनाभस्य धीमतः ।शिरोभिः चरणौ स्पृष्ट्वा कन्या शतम् अभाषत ॥१-३३-१॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ ।śirobhiḥ caraṇau spṛṣṭvā kanyā śatam abhāṣata ॥1-33-1॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of sagacious Kusanabha, his hundred daughters touched his feet with their heads and said:
translations.hindi: Ce रौ अ ~ ऊपतुमुंदितो वीरो प्रहष्टेनान्तरात्मना

verses.sloka: वायुः सर्वात्मको राजन् प्रधर्षयितुम् इच्छति ।अशुभम् मार्गम् आस्थाय न धर्मम् प्रत्यवेक्षते ॥१-३३-२॥
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ sarvātmako rājan pradharṣayitum icchati ।aśubham mārgam āsthāya na dharmam pratyavekṣate ॥1-33-2॥

translations.english: "O king, the allpervading Windgod, having taken recourse to foul means intended to outrage our modesty without and moral compunction.

verses.sloka: पितृमत्यः स्म भद्रम् ते स्वच्छन्दे न वयम् स्थिताः ।पितरम् नो वृणीष्व त्वम् यदि नो दास्यते तव ॥१-३३-३॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛmatyaḥ sma bhadram te svacchande na vayam sthitāḥ ।pitaram no vṛṇīṣva tvam yadi no dāsyate tava ॥1-33-3॥

translations.english: We have our father who is dear to us. Hence we do not have freedom to choose. You may ask our father if he is willing to give us (in marriage).
translations.hindi: सबेरा होने पर शौचादि कर्मों से निश्चिन्त हो, दोनों भाई -विश्वामित्र तथा अन्य ऋषियों को प्रणाम करने गये ।;२॥ अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्‌ । ऊचतुर्मधुरोदारं वाक्यं मधुरभाषिणौ

verses.sloka: तेन पाप अनुबन्धेन वचनम् न प्रतीच्छता ।एवम् ब्रुवंत्यः सर्वाः स्म वायुना अभिहता भृषम् ॥१-३३-४॥
verses.transliteration: tena pāpa anubandhena vacanam na pratīcchatā ।evam bruvaṁtyaḥ sarvāḥ sma vāyunā abhihatā bhṛṣam ॥1-33-4॥

translations.english: As all of us were speaking thus, the sinful Windgod, disregarding our words repeatedly assaulted us.

verses.sloka: तासाम् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजा परम धार्मिकः ।प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः कन्या शतम् अनुत्तमम् ॥१-३३-५॥
verses.transliteration: tāsām tu vacanam śrutvā rājā parama dhārmikaḥ ।pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ kanyā śatam anuttamam ॥1-33-5॥

translations.english: The deeply religious and highly powerful king, having heard those words of his one hundred exceptional daughters, replied:
translations.hindi: उन दोनों राजकुमारों को इस प्रकार बोलते सुन, विश्वामित्र जी को अगुवा बना, सब महर्षियो ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा

verses.sloka: क्षान्तम् क्षमावताम् पुत्र्यः कर्तव्यम् सुमहत् कृतम् ।ऐकमत्यम् उपागम्य कुलम् च आवेक्षितम् मम ॥१-३३-६॥
verses.transliteration: kṣāntam kṣamāvatām putryaḥ kartavyam sumahat kṛtam ।aikamatyam upāgamya kulam ca āvekṣitam mama ॥1-33-6॥

translations.english: "O daughters you have done a great act of forgiveness of which only the tolerant are capable. By taking a united stand, you have protected the honour of my dynasty.
translations.hindi: हे नरश्रेष्ठ ! परम धर्मिष्ठ मिथिलाधीश महाराज जनक के यहाँ यज्ञ होने वाला है । हम लोग सब वहाँ जा रहे हैं

verses.sloka: अलंकारो हि नारीणाम् क्षमा तु पुरुषस्य वा ।दुष्करम् तत् च वै क्षान्तम् त्रिदशेषु विशेषतः ॥१-३३-७॥
verses.transliteration: alaṁkāro hi nārīṇām kṣamā tu puruṣasya vā ।duṣkaram tat ca vai kṣāntam tridaśeṣu viśeṣataḥ ॥1-33-7॥

translations.english: Whether for women or men forgiveness is an ornament. It is difficult even for gods. For you, daughters, to show it without any difference of opinion is especially hard.

verses.sloka: यादृशीः वः क्षमा पुत्र्यः सर्वासाम् अविशेषतः ।क्षमा दानम् क्षमा सत्यम् क्षमा यज्ञः च पुत्रिकाः ॥१-३३-८॥
verses.transliteration: yādṛśīḥ vaḥ kṣamā putryaḥ sarvāsām aviśeṣataḥ ।kṣamā dānam kṣamā satyam kṣamā yajñaḥ ca putrikāḥ ॥1-33-8॥

translations.english: "Forbearance is charity, forbearance is sacrifice, forbearance is truth, forbearance is glory and forbearance is virtue. O daughters, the universe is supported by forbearance".
translations.hindi: बा० रा०--१५ ; पूर्वकाल में देवताओं ने वह धनुष जनक को दिया था। वह धनुष बड़ा भारी और बहुत ही चमकदार है

verses.sloka: क्षमा यशः क्षमा धर्मः क्षमायाम् विष्ठितम् जगत् ।विसृज्य कन्याः काकुत्स्थ राजा त्रिदश विक्रमः ॥१-३३-९॥
verses.transliteration: kṣamā yaśaḥ kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamāyām viṣṭhitam jagat ।visṛjya kanyāḥ kākutstha rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ ॥1-33-9॥

translations.english: "O Rama after sending away his daughters, the king endowed with the power of the celestials and wellversed in the art of counselling, consulted his ministers about a suitable person for marriage of his daughters at proper time and place.

verses.sloka: मंत्रज्ञो मंत्रयामास प्रदानम् सह मंत्रिभिः ।देशे काले च कर्तव्यम् सदृशे प्रतिपादनम् ॥१-३३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: maṁtrajño maṁtrayāmāsa pradānam saha maṁtribhiḥ ।deśe kāle ca kartavyam sadṛśe pratipādanam ॥1-33-10॥

translations.english: "O Rama after sending away his daughters, the king endowed with the power of the celestials and wellversed in the art of counselling, consulted his ministers about a suitable person for marriage of his daughters at proper time and place.

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु चूली नाम महाद्युतिः ।ऊर्ध्व रेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मम् तप उपागमत् ॥१-३३-११॥
verses.transliteration: etasmin eva kāle tu cūlī nāma mahādyutiḥ ।ūrdhva retāḥ śubhācāro brāhmam tapa upāgamat ॥1-33-11॥

translations.english: At that time a great and virtuous ascetic named Chuli living in celebacy was performing austerities in pursuit of the knowledge of Brahman.

verses.sloka: तपस्यंतम् ऋषिम् तत्र गंधर्वी पर्युपासते ।सोमदा नाम भद्रम् ते ऊर्मिला तनया तदा ॥१-३३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: tapasyaṁtam ṛṣim tatra gaṁdharvī paryupāsate ।somadā nāma bhadram te ūrmilā tanayā tadā ॥1-33-12॥

translations.english: When he was performing austerities, a nymph named Somada, daughter of Urmila, used to serve him. Prosperity to you
translations.hindi: हे रामचन्द्र ! एक समय महाराज जनक ने यज्ञ किया और , उस यज्ञ के फलस्वरूप सुनाभ नामक उत्तम धनुष उन्होंने सब देवताओं से माँग लिया

verses.sloka: सा च तम् प्रणता भूत्वा शुश्रूषण परायणा ।उवास काले धर्मिष्ठा तस्याः तुष्टो अभवत् गुरुः ॥१-३३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sā ca tam praṇatā bhūtvā śuśrūṣaṇa parāyaṇā ।uvāsa kāle dharmiṣṭhā tasyāḥ tuṣṭo abhavat guruḥ ॥1-33-13॥

translations.english: Somada rendered her services with devotion and humility. There she lived a religious life. In the might time her spiritual guide was satisfied with her services.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे-विविैगन्धेर्माल्येश्चागरुगन्धिभिः । व. धचुष मिथिलाधीरा के घर में पूजा के स्थान पर रखा रहता है और धूप-दीपादि से नित्य उसका पूजन किया जाता है

verses.sloka: स च ताम् काल योगेन प्रोवाच रघु नंदन ।परितुष्टो अस्मि भद्रम् ते किम् करोमि तव प्रियम् ॥१-३३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca tām kāla yogena provāca raghu naṁdana ।parituṣṭo asmi bhadram te kim karomi tava priyam ॥1-33-14॥

translations.english: When her services came to a fruition with the passage of time, maharshi Chuli, spoke to her: 'I am pleased with you. What favour shall I do for you? May you be prosperous'
translations.hindi: यह कह व मुनिप्रवर विश्वामित्र ने वहाँ से प्रस्थान किया । उनके साथ दोनों राजकुमार तथा ऋषिगण भी गए । चलते समय विश्वामित्र जी ने वनदेवताओं को बुला कर उनसे कहा--तुम्हारा कल्याण हो, मेरी यज्ञक्रिया सुसम्पन्न हुई । अब में सिद्धाश्रम सेश्रीगङ्गा जी के उत्तर तट पर ओर हिमालय पर्वत की तराई में होकर ( जनकपुर ) जाऊँगा

verses.sloka: परितुष्टम् मुनिम् ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुर स्वरम् ।उवाच परम प्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्य कोविदम् ॥१-३३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: parituṣṭam munim jñātvā gandharvī madhura svaram ।uvāca parama prītā vākyajñā vākya kovidam ॥1-33-15॥

translations.english: Having perceived that the sage was satisfied, the gandharva who was skilled in speech said exceedingly delighted to the sage in a sweet voice.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्म्या समुदितो ब्राह्म्या ब्रह्म भूतो महातपाः ।ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तम् पुत्रम् इच्छामि धार्मिकम् ॥१-३३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmyā samudito brāhmyā brahma bhūto mahātapāḥ ।brāhmeṇa tapasā yuktam putram icchāmi dhārmikam ॥1-33-16॥

translations.english: Bestowed with the great asceticism and brilliance of a brahmin, you look like Brahma. O righteous one, I desire a son endowed with the ascetic virtues of a brahmin.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर उस उत्तम सिद्धाश्रम कौ परिक्रमा कर, बे उत्तर की ओर रवाना हुए

verses.sloka: अपतिः च अस्मि भद्रम् ते भार्या च अस्मि न कस्यचित् ।ब्राह्मेण उपगतायाः च दातुम् अर्हसि मे सुतम् ॥१-३३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: apatiḥ ca asmi bhadram te bhāryā ca asmi na kasyacit ।brāhmeṇa upagatāyāḥ ca dātum arhasi me sutam ॥1-33-17॥

translations.english: I am without a husband, my sire. I am not a wife to any one. Since I have taken refuge in you, you are competent to bestow on me a son with the power of your penance".

verses.sloka: तस्याः प्रसन्नो ब्रह्मर्षिर् ददौ ब्राह्मम् अनुत्तमम् ।ब्रह्मदत्त इति ख्यातम् मानसम् चूलिनः सुतम् ॥१-३३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ prasanno brahmarṣir dadau brāhmam anuttamam ।brahmadatta iti khyātam mānasam cūlinaḥ sutam ॥1-33-18॥

translations.english: Pleased with her, brahmarshi Chuli gave her an excellent son to be wellknown as Brahmadatta born through the will of his mind.

verses.sloka: स राजा ब्रह्मदत्तः तु पुरीम् अध्यवसत् तदा ।कांपिल्याम् परया लक्ष्म्या देवराजो यथा दिवम् ॥१-३३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sa rājā brahmadattaḥ tu purīm adhyavasat tadā ।kāṁpilyām parayā lakṣmyā devarājo yathā divam ॥1-33-19॥

translations.english: Then king Brahmadatta, son of Somada, lived in the city of Kampilya with great prosperity like Indra in heaven.

verses.sloka: स बुद्धिम् कृतवान् राजा कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः ।ब्रह्मदत्ताय काकुत्स्थ दातुम् कन्या शतम् तदा ॥१-३३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: sa buddhim kṛtavān rājā kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ ।brahmadattāya kākutstha dātum kanyā śatam tadā ॥1-33-20॥

translations.english: O Rama, then the highly righteous king Kusanabha decided to give his hundred daughters to Brahmadatta".
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--शोण--सोन नदी का नाम है, जो गोंडवाने से निकल पटना के पास गङ्गा में गिरती है। ] तब सब लोगों ने शोण नदी के तट पर डेरा डाला | सूर्ये के अस्त होने पर उन लोगों ने स्नान कर सन्ध्योपासन और अग्नि- होत्र किया

verses.sloka: तम् आहूय महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तम् महीपतिः ।ददौ कन्या शतम् राजा सुप्रीतेन अंतरात्मना ॥१-३३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: tam āhūya mahātejā brahmadattam mahīpatiḥ ।dadau kanyā śatam rājā suprītena aṁtarātmanā ॥1-33-21॥

translations.english: The lord of the earth, highly powerful king Kusanabha invited Brahmadatta, and gave his hundred daughters in marriage to him with a heart highly pleased.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सब मुनि, विश्वामित्र को आगे कर बैठे । श्रीरम- चन्द्र और लक्ष्मण ने सब सुनियों का पूजन किया और

verses.sloka: यथा क्रमम् ततः पाणिम् जग्राह रघुनंदन ।ब्रह्मदत्तो महीपालः तासाम् देवपतिर् यथा ॥१-३३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: yathā kramam tataḥ pāṇim jagrāha raghunaṁdana ।brahmadatto mahīpālaḥ tāsām devapatir yathā ॥1-33-22॥

translations.english: O son of Raghu's dynasty that king Brahmadatta resembling Indra received the hands of those maidens' in due order.

verses.sloka: स्पृष्ट मात्रे ततः पाणौ विकुब्जा विगत ज्वराः ।युक्ताः परमया लक्ष्म्या बभौ कन्या शतम् तदा ॥१-३३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: spṛṣṭa mātre tataḥ pāṇau vikubjā vigata jvarāḥ ।yuktāḥ paramayā lakṣmyā babhau kanyā śatam tadā ॥1-33-23॥

translations.english: Thereafter, with the mere touch of his hand, the hundred daughters were cured of their hump back and freed from anguish. They assumed great beauty.
translations.hindi: कौतूहलपूर्वक पूछा कि हे भगवन्‌! यह हरे-भरे वन वाला देश कौनसा है ? में यह जानना चाहता हूँ। कृपया मुझे इसका ठीक-ठीक वृत्तान्त बतलाइए

verses.sloka: स दृष्ट्वा वायुना मुक्ताः कुशनाभो महीपतिः ।बभूव परम प्रीतो हर्षम् लेभे पुनः पुनः ॥१-३३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā vāyunā muktāḥ kuśanābho mahīpatiḥ ।babhūva parama prīto harṣam lebhe punaḥ punaḥ ॥1-33-24॥

translations.english: King Kusanabha, having seen his daughters released from disfigurement caused by the Windgod was immensely pleased. He experienced waves of delight.
translations.hindi: इति एकत्रिशः सगं: ॥ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के इस प्रकार पूछने पर, महातेजस्वी और सुब्रत विश्वामित्र जो ने प्रसन्न हो, उन सव ऋषियों के बीच बैठ कर, उस देश का सारा हाल बतलाया

verses.sloka: कृत उद्वाहम् तु राजानम् ब्रह्मदत्तम् महीपतिः ।सदारम् प्रेषयामास स उपाध्याय गणम् तदा ॥१-३३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta udvāham tu rājānam brahmadattam mahīpatiḥ ।sadāram preṣayāmāsa sa upādhyāya gaṇam tadā ॥1-33-25॥

translations.english: Then the king along with his queens performed the marriage of his daughters in the assembly of priests and sent them with Brahmadatta (to his kingdom).

verses.sloka: सोमदा अपि सुतम् दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्य सदृशीम् क्रियाम् ।यथा न्यायम् च गन्धर्वी स्नुषाः ताः प्रत्यनंदत ।स्पृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा च ताः कन्याः कुशनाभम् प्रशस्य च ॥१-३३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: somadā api sutam dṛṣṭvā putrasya sadṛśīm kriyām ।yathā nyāyam ca gandharvī snuṣāḥ tāḥ pratyanaṁdata ।spṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca tāḥ kanyāḥ kuśanābham praśasya ca ॥1-33-26॥

translations.english: Somada the gandharvi was exeedingly delighted with her daughtersinlaw and praised her son for his right action. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डेण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the thirtythird sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
